title: Tried building my own AI Game Maker - games from prompts
author: RepresentativeUse115
selftext:
Spent the last few months on an Android app that generates playable games from text prompts.

You describe the game, it builds it, and you can play it right away on your phone. For best results I’ve found the free DeepSeek model gives best 3D results and fewest broken mechanics so far.

Still very early - mostly simple arcade-style games, limited iteration, Describe a game → playable result + GitHub repo (similar to how Google Jules handles projects).

Link if anyone wants to poke at it:  
[https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=ai.game.maker](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=ai.game.maker)

comments.author: thecrownforge
comments.body: the GitHub repo is useful. can a player change one rule after generation without rebuilding the whole game? i'd test that with a small change like enemy speed. if it breaks, showing what changed in the files may help people fix it.
